Figure 1: Retrieval Framework. The time-series encoder fθ uses labeled dataset S and create a metric space where similar tasks are grouped together and create prototypes while different tasks are separated from each others. The embeddings of unlabeled trajectories U are compared with prototypes using learned metric Dist(.) to find the closest match and create retrieved set R.
